ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately a 40:60 ratio of low-intensity (dark) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity region at the peduncle junction. Left lobe displays a high-intensity field intersected by multiple low-intensity linear vectors. Right lobe displays a high-intensity field with a localized mid-intensity yellowish-brown mottled patch near the notch and several low-intensity linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 95 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/6th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; highest pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks) are localized on the distal 20% of the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit concave sweep; trailing edges follow a macro-convex trajectory from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse detection of small, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters (sub-10 pixel diameter) scattered on the high-intensity regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white fields vertically and diagonally, most prominent on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notched tissue loss on the distal trailing edges and a distinct yellowish-brown mid-intensity patch on the inner right lobe near the notch.
